title: Hybrid layer-sensitivity quant profiles and automated calibration flow for reranker accuracy gating
creator: Maya Chen
description: This ticket defines and implements a hybrid per-layer sensitivity profiling and automated calibration pipeline for our reranker models. Goal: produce deployable quantization profiles (FP8/INT8 mixed) that meet NDCG@10 and MRR service-level gates without manual per-model tinkering. The work spans data selection for calibration, per-layer metric collection, profile generation heuristics, an automated validation harness that computes slice-aware NDCG/MRR deltas, and a canary-based rollout with rollback on quality regressions.
background: We have many ad-hoc quant profiles for rerankers built during experiments. Manual calibration is time-consuming and brittle across datasets and query slices. Recent customer incidents revealed regressions after a naive INT8 sweep on ranker head layers. We need an automated workflow that: 1) finds layers sensitive to aggressive quantization, 2) synthesizes hybrid profiles (FP8 on sensitive layers + INT8 elsewhere), 3) validates profiles against production-like ranking metrics (NDCG, MRR) and slice-level thresholds, and 4) integrates into our rollout/rollback controls for Dedicated and Hosted.
proposed_solution: 1) Per-layer sensitivity measurement: run a short calibration job per model variant that collects activation & weight histograms, KL divergence, absolute score delta per-layer (on a held-out calibration corpus). 2) Sensitivity matrix: combine statistical signals (KL, dynamic range, max/min outliers) with downstream signal (per-layer induced delta in NDCG@10 on a tiny validation split) to rank layers by sensitivity. 3) Hybrid profile generator: pick a knee point in sensitivity ranking; mark top-k layers as FP8 (or keep fp32/float fallback), quantize remaining to INT8 using symmetric/asymmetric schemes per-tensor. 4) Calibration automation: a pipeline stage that runs on dedicated GPU pool (A100 / L4 fallback), seeds RNGs deterministically, checkpoints intermediate artifacts (calibration histograms, candidate profiles), and emits a profile bundle tagged with model-version + calibration-hash. 5) Validation harness: compute global and slice-aware NDCG@1/3/10 and MRR for candidate profiles vs control float32; require both absolute NDCG delta < 0.5% and per-slice delta < 1.0% for high-traffic slices. 6) Rollout: canary -> gradual rollout with continuous monitoring of rank metrics and token/latency footprints; automatic rollback on threshold violations.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline can produce a hybrid FP8/INT8 profile bundle for a target reranker model with no manual tuning
Validation harness calculates NDCG@10 and MRR deltas reproducibly (seeded runs) against float32 baseline
Profiles that pass automated gates include per-layer quantization map and calibration artifacts and are versioned in model catalog
Canary deployment automation will rollback to previous profile if global NDCG drop > 0.5% or any high-traffic slice drop > 1.0% within 1 hour of rollout
Nightly sweep job runs at least one model calibration and uploads artifacts to the build bucket for audits
qa_plan: Unit tests for sensitivity scorer (mock histograms)
Integration test: small reranker toy model run through full pipeline on staging cluster (A100) verifying profile generation + validation
Deterministic end-to-end runs with 3 different seeds to assert measurement stability (<0.1% variance on NDCG delta under same profile)
Load test canary to validate latency/throughput impact of hybrid profile under realistic QPS
Adversarial slice test: run synthetic perturbations (typos, long queries, heavy entity density) to ensure no slice regresses beyond threshold
rollout_plan: Deploy profile to staging -> run full validation harness -> create canary rollout in hosted region-us-east with 1% traffic for 2 hours; monitor NDCG/MRR and token-cost metrics; if green, ramp to 25% for 4 hours; if still green, complete to 100%. Automated rollback triggers: global NDCG@10 drop > 0.5% OR any labeled high-priority slice drop > 1.0% OR observed API latency increase > 10% p90. Post-rollout: run 24-hour quality drift job comparing rolling traffic to baseline and surface any slow regressions.
runbook: Step 1: Kick off calibration job: ./infra/calib_launcher --model <id> --dataset calib-v2 --profile-out <s3path> --seed 1234
Step 2: Monitor job logs in jobs.rw.redwood/inference-calib and ensure histograms were produced within 20 minutes
Step 3: Review generated sensitivity matrix in the profile bundle (artifact sensitivity_matrix.csv) and check that the top-10 layers are flagged for FP8 candidate consideration
Step 4: Trigger validation harness: ./validate_profile --profile <s3path> --baseline float32 --slices slice-config.yaml
Step 5: If validation passes, promote profile to candidate registry and start canary via console or CLI (console action: Promote -> Deploy Canary)

Step 6: If canary fails, run automated revert: console will flip profile pointer to previous model-version and scale canary down; open an incident and attach artifacts (sensitivity_matrix.csv, ndcg_report.csv, run logs)
Step 7: For persistent failures, mark profile with label 'needs-manual-review' and assign to quant team for manual layer-specific adjustments
